source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the functioning of the kidney (PDF 16-17).

blocks.text: Gurde khoon se metabolic fuzlaat aur zaid pani chhaan kar peshab (urine) ki shakal mein bahar nikalte hain. Peshab banne ke amal ke teen bare qadam hain jo nephron mein hote hain: glomerular filtration (chhanna), selective reabsorption (chun kar wapas lena) aur tubular secretion (tubule mein dalna).

blocks.title: Gurde: excretion bhi, osmoregulation bhi
blocks.text: Fuzlaat nikalne (excretion) ke saath saath gurde osmoregulation ka kaam bhi karte hain. Jab jism ki rutoobatein hypotonic (zyada patli) hon to gurde patla peshab banate hain, aur jab rutoobatein hypertonic (zyada gaarhi) hon aur jism mein pani ki kami (dehydration) ho to gaarha peshab banate hain. Is tarah gurde jism ki rutoobaton mein namak ki miqdar qaboo karte hain.

Peshab banne ka pehla qadam ek physical (tabai, kimiyai nahin) amal hai jise glomerular filtration (ya ultrafiltration) kehte hain. Efferent arteriole afferent arteriole se patli (narrow) hoti hai. Is farq ki wajah se glomerulus ki capillaries mein khoon nisbatan zyada dabao (high pressure) par rehta hai. Yeh zyada dabao pani, urea, glucose, amino acids, vitamins aur mukhtalif namak (Na⁺, K⁺, Cl⁻) ko khoon se dhakel kar Bowman's capsule mein bhej deta hai. Khoon ke mayi (fluid) hisse ka taqreeban paanchwan hissa (20%) chhan kar Bowman's capsule mein jata hai; ise glomerular filtrate kehte hain. Plasma proteins (maslan albumin aur globulins) aur khoon ke cells itne bare hain ke capillaries ki deewar se nahin guzar sakte, is liye yeh khoon hi mein reh jate hain.

Glomerular filtrate mein sirf fuzlaat nahin balke zaroori ghizai madde (nutrients) bhi hote hain jinhen jism zaya nahin kar sakta. Selective reabsorption woh amal hai jis mein kaam ki cheezen renal tubule se wapas peritubular capillaries mein le jayi jati hain. Zyada tar reabsorption proximal convoluted tubule mein hota hai. Yahan filtrate ka taqreeban 75% pani osmosis se wapas capillaries mein chala jata hai. Glucose, amino acids aur namak (sodium, potassium aur calcium) active transport (tawanai laga kar) se proximal tubule se wapas khoon mein jate hain. Filtrate aage barhta hai to loop of Henle ki descending limb mein mazeed pani wapas liya jata hai. Ascending limb se pani nahin guzarta (impermeable), lekin yeh active transport se namak ko tubule se bahar nikalti hai. Distal convoluted tubule se bhi kuch pani aur namak jazb hote hain. Collecting duct pani wapas lene ki aakhri jagah hai.

Tubular secretion reabsorption ka ulat hai. Is amal mein distal convoluted tubule ke epithelial cells aas paas ke khoon se kuch cheezen le kar filtrate mein dal dete hain. In cheezon mein hydrogen ions, ammonium, potassium ions, aur mukhtalif metabolic zehreele madde ya dawaon ke baqiyat (maslan penicillin) shamil hain. Hydrogen ions ki tubular secretion se gurde khoon ka acid-base tawazun (pH) qaim rakhne mein kirdar ada karte hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab yahan secretion distal convoluted tubule mein batati hai. Yeh bhi jaan lein ke secretion proximal tubule mein bhi hoti hai (maslan penicillin jaisi kai dawaen wahin secrete hoti hain) aur collecting duct mein bhi.

Collecting ducts se peshab renal pelvis se hota hua ureter mein jata hai. Ureter peshab ko urinary bladder tak le jati hai. Bladder ke muscles sukar kar peshab ko urethra ke raste jism se bahar nikalte hain. Ek sehatmand baligh (adult) din mein 1 se 2 L peshab karta hai. Yeh miqdar bohat badalti rehti hai aur kai cheezon par munhasir hai. Hum jitna zyada pani ya mashroobat (hydrating fluids) peete hain, utna zyada peshab banta hai. Zyada namak wali khurak jism mein pani rok leti hai aur peshab kam banta hai. Warzish mein saans aur paseene se pani zaya hota hai, is liye aam taur par peshab kam hota hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Garam mausam mein paseene se jism ka zyada pani zaya hota hai, is liye gurde pani bachate hain aur thora aur gaarha peshab banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Glucose khoon mein hota hai magar aam taur par peshab mein kyun nahi hota?
blocks.explanation: Glucose Bowman's capsule mein chhan jata hai, magar proximal convoluted tubule mein active transport se sara khoon mein wapas le liya jata hai.

items: Peshab banne ke teen qadam: glomerular filtration, selective reabsorption, tubular secretion.
Filtration: patli efferent arteriole se glomerulus mein zyada dabao; khoon ke mayi hisse ka 20% filtrate banta hai; proteins aur cells khoon mein rehte hain.
Reabsorption: zyada tar PCT mein (75% pani osmosis se; glucose, amino acids, namak active transport se); collecting duct aakhri jagah.
Secretion: H⁺, ammonium, K⁺, zehreele madde aur dawaen (penicillin) filtrate mein; H⁺ se khoon ka pH qaboo.
Peshab: collecting duct, renal pelvis, ureter, bladder, urethra; din mein 1 se 2 L.
